title: SharePoint and Windows file shares
intro: If your company has connected SharePoint or a Windows file share, you can browse it from Depot. Files stay where they are.

sections.heading: Open a connection
steps: Click a name under **Connections**, near the bottom of the left rail.
Click **Upload** to add files from your computer.
Click **New folder** to add a folder here.
Click **Download** on a file's row to save a copy.
Click **Share** on a SharePoint file's row to see your sharing options.
bullets: Click **Rename** or **Delete** on a file's row to rename or remove it.
Click a SharePoint file's name to open it in Microsoft 365.
Windows file shares have no **Share** button.

sections.heading: Share a SharePoint file
steps: Click **Copy view link** to copy a link anyone can open.
Click **Copy edit link** to copy a link people can also change.
Click **Email people…** to send it to named people by email.

sections.heading: Unlock a personal Windows share
text: Some Windows file shares ask for your own network sign-in the first time, so you see only what your account allows.
sections.note: Depot uses your sign-in only for this session, and never saves it. On a shared computer, click **Lock** at the top of the share to make Depot forget it straight away.
